name: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
desc: 255 g nonfat Greek yogurt, 1 cup blueberries, 1 tbsp chia, 1 oz almonds.

name: Overnight Oats & Whey
desc: 40 g oats soaked in 1 cup skim milk with ¾ scoop whey isolate, ½ cup blueberries, 1 tbsp chia. Build the night before.

name: Egg Scramble & Toast
desc: 2 whole eggs + 4 whites scrambled in ½ tbsp olive oil with wilted spinach, 2 slices low-sodium toast.
note: Butter is where the saturated fat goes — use the oil instead.

name: Veggie Egg White Omelette
desc: 6 egg whites folded over bell pepper and onion, 1 slice low-sodium toast.
note: The lowest-fat breakfast on the deck — nearly all whites, no yolks.

name: Cottage Cheese Fruit Bowl
desc: 1 cup no-salt-added cottage cheese, banana, blueberries, ½ oz walnuts.

name: Roast Chicken over Greens
desc: 150 g roast chicken, 2 cups mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, olive oil & lemon, a baked sweet potato.

name: No-Salt Tuna Salad
desc: 1½ cans no-salt-added tuna bound with Greek yogurt instead of mayo, over greens, one slice low-sodium toast, an apple.

name: Chickpea Penne Salad + Chicken
desc: 57 g dry Banza penne, cooked and chilled, 120 g chicken, cherry tomatoes, basil, olive oil and red wine vinegar.

name: Salmon & Quinoa Bowl
desc: 150 g salmon, 1 cup quinoa, mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, olive oil.

name: Turkey & Sweet Potato Bowl
desc: 120 g roasted turkey breast, a baked sweet potato, mixed greens, olive oil.

name: Roast Chicken, Herb Potatoes & Green Beans
desc: 150 g roast chicken, one russet roasted in olive oil with rosemary and garlic, 1½ cups green beans.
note: Roast extra — 350 g cooked covers two lunches this week.

name: Chickpea Penne Pomodoro + Chicken
desc: 85 g dry Banza penne, ¾ cup no-salt-added crushed tomatoes, 120 g shredded chicken, garlic, basil, 1 tbsp parmesan.
note: Go light on salting the pasta water — pasta absorbs more than you'd think.

name: Baked Salmon, Quinoa & Asparagus
desc: 150 g salmon with lemon and dill, 1 cup quinoa, 1½ cups roasted asparagus.
note: Cook extra salmon — the leftover becomes tomorrow's lunch bowl.

name: Fish Tacos & Cabbage-Lime Slaw
desc: 170 g tilapia, chili-lime rubbed, three corn tortillas, shredded cabbage in lime juice, Greek-yogurt crema.
note: Corn tortillas run 11 mg sodium each; flour tortillas run 200+.

name: Turkey Cutlets, Sweet Potato Mash & Broccoli
desc: 150 g fresh turkey breast cutlets, sweet potato mashed with a splash of skim milk, 1½ cups roasted broccoli.
note: Fresh turkey breast, never deli — deli slices run 700-1,000 mg sodium per 100 g.

name: Garlic-Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
desc: 150 g chicken, 2 cups peppers and onion, 1 cup broccoli, over 1 cup rice. Sauce: unsalted stock, ginger, garlic, rice vinegar, 1 tbsp coconut aminos.
note: One tbsp of aminos is 90 mg sodium; the same amount of soy sauce would be 900.

name: Chickpea Penne Pesto + Grilled Chicken
desc: 85 g dry Banza, 130 g grilled chicken, side salad. Homemade pesto: basil, garlic, ½ oz walnuts, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp parmesan, lemon.
note: Homemade pesto is the point — jarred runs 400-500 mg sodium per two tablespoons.

name: Bedtime Yogurt, Banana & Oats
desc: 170 g Greek yogurt, one banana, 20 g raw oats stirred in.
note: The nightly non-negotiable — see the evidence note on the main plan.

name: Bedtime Cottage Cheese, Banana & Oats
desc: ½ cup no-salt-added cottage cheese, one banana, 20 g oats.

name: Apple & Peanut Butter
desc: One apple, 1 tbsp unsalted peanut butter.
note: Good as an afternoon bridge, not a substitute for the bedtime snack.
